notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Allies.
description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
